name: FeMoco walk step
headline: The cheapest controlled qubitized walk step for FeMoco.
summary: FeMoco is the standard benchmark molecule of fault-tolerant quantum chemistry. Phase estimation repeats one walk step tens of thousands of times, so the cost of that step sets the cost of the computation. The challenge fixes the Hamiltonian, the encoding and the error model, and asks for the best circuit.

metric.label: Effective 1-norm x Toffolis per step x peak qubits

levels.name: Architecture
levels.description: How the circuit delivers rotation angles: the primary unit of search. Each architecture keeps its own best circuit.

levels.name: Circuit
levels.description: One point within an architecture: its levers, widths and schedules.

standard: Spectrum-amplified sum-of-squares encoding with the estimated rounding class of Low et al. 2025. One standard for both tracks.
rules: Only the circuit builders under src/walk may change.
Every sampled lane must apply exactly the declared operator, restore every ancilla and leave no phase behind.
Recorded circuits must stay byte-identical; new behaviour sits behind a new build knob.
A circuit is recorded if it is the first or the best of its architecture, or advances the Toffoli-qubit front.
The judge's run on the pull request is the result; local runs are not.
